latest_repo_validation.scope: PR image build, metadata, Trivy, API and worker image health; not registry publish proof

staging.note: Repository CI proved the isolated PostgreSQL/Redis/Bearer-auth staging topology. A real externally deployed production-like staging environment and build-once promotion lifecycle are not confirmed by this evidence.

production.note: No authoritative production deployment evidence is retained in the repository readiness manifest.

twilio_sms.note: PR #277 proves durable invitation intent, provider ambiguity fencing, terminal/DLQ recovery and truthful UI on exact code. No real external Twilio round-trip is retained, so provider acceptance/delivery is not externally verified.

latest_repo_restore_drill.scope: PostgreSQL logical backup, isolated restore, schema and deterministic data fingerprint verification

observability.note: Backend observability controls exist in the repository, but production-grade end-to-end observability, mobile crash reporting and a retained staging alert-delivery probe are not yet proven complete.

legal_privacy.note: Terms/Privacy, retention, export/delete, subprocessors, payment/legal and jurisdiction validation require external approval evidence.

manual_payment_evidence.note: Current main has paid_unverified transfer acknowledgement, but not the complete evidence upload, authorized reviewer approve/reject, safe resubmission and single-recognition financial lifecycle.

warranty_claim_idempotency.note: Warranty create remains retryable/offline-capable without a durable create idempotency identity, leaving duplicate issue/document/event risk.

chat_read_truth.note: Explicit server message cursor, side-effect-free reads, monotonic DB fencing, visibility-gated mobile read receipts and authoritative reconciliation are merged. Equal-timestamp precision is tracked separately as non-launch-blocking P2 #271.

phone_chat_invitation_delivery.note: Durable deterministic invitation identity, DomainOutbox delivery intent, SMS ambiguous-write fencing/operator recovery, OTP activation, exact thread-scoped ACL/inbox/WS, recipient notifications and truthful mobile delivery states are merged. Full backend regression passed 975 tests with 6 skipped; PostgreSQL Alembic and Playwright passed. Real Twilio provider round-trip remains externally unverified.

archived_chat_unread_truth.note: Archived threads can still remain hidden after later incoming communication; message creation still lacks a durable client request identity and the message/archive/notification-outbox mutation is not yet one atomic business transaction. Thread-only mobile project-action capability UX also remains to be closed.

development_runtime.note: Current local launcher does not reproduce the production topology: root compose lacks Redis/API/dedicated Worker, startup may install Python packages ad-hoc and swallows Alembic failure, and canonical dev check/reset/logs/seed/stop lifecycle commands are absent.

real external production-like staging capacity/provider-degradation evidence is not proven

controlled real-user pilot, product telemetry, legal/privacy acceptance and launch operations are not complete
real GitHub/org privileged-access review is not executed
independent pre-launch penetration and abuse test is not executed

launch_decision.reason: Broad production remains blocked by external staging/promotion, disaster recovery, observability/alerting, governance, capacity, provider, product-integrity, reproducible runtime, pilot/legal/operations and security evidence gaps.
